answers.reader_answer_quote: For an ordinary Elephant-located Crisis, the tail is attacker/acting region and head is defender. A sovereign actor (large capital flag or unflagged dome) makes an Invasion; a dominated actor (small flag or no dome) rebels against its sovereign. Elephant fully inside a Company region means Rebellion against Company. This classifier is for ordinary Crisis, not Foreign Invasion. Sovereign/domination is identified by flag/dome status as described: sovereign regions have dome without flag or capital/star flag; dominated regions have small flag or no dome.
